answer: Require every agent to lock a small refundable bond before its answers count, and slash a slice of it each time peers reject its work as copied or incoherent. A single relic of a bond is cheap for one honest agent, but a sybil farm must fund a fresh bond per fake, so its cost climbs like a dune with every copy while its reward stays flat. In the tundra of free identities, a bond that can be lost is the cheapest proof that someone stands behind the work.
